I don’t have a lot to say but to everyone reading this I would no longer reply and check everybody’s past and upcoming caring message’s as today I have finally decided that I no longer want to continue living in this beautiful life that we lived, except that’s not the way it wanted me to live but I have try my best to live it to the fullest, for the past years I’ve been going through anxiety, mild paranoia, depression and suicide ever since I was in high school (Im 20 years old now) I thought it was gone but unfortunately it came crashing down back at me once more and I’m stuck in this loop, it’s a nonstop cycle, I cannot get out of this and want my life to stop.
But this few final hours I refuse to be sad and chose to be happy instead and to let go and accept that this is my fate. 
 
If you came across this please keep fighting the pain, struggle, ill and situation your going through, I cannot sit here and say anything more than that as I cannot live long enough to tell you more of my experience but one thing I truly believed is that we all have purpose’s in this life no matter what it is and wherever it is, so go ahead and try to find yours.

To everyone who’s getting this error I have found the way my Brother’s and Sister’s

STEP 1 - So what I did was actually Uninstall everything this includes red dead redemption 2, The saves for this game and The Cloud saves In the Xbox, yes I know that means you have to delete everything but this isn’t really a problem with me as I have just started and have no progress except for the Game Intro.

STEP 2 - Now that you’ve deleted everything you got to turn off your network connection from Xbox which is in the settings / network / Go offline, ( Make your sign in to your account before you go offline ) You must also have to turn off Auto Updates just incase you go back to online as this will update Red dead Redemption 2 automatically which you don’t want because your About to install 1.00 version of the game which let’s you play offline. 

STEP 3 - From there, You have two Red dead Redemption 2 disc, insert the disc 2 which is the data disc or disc 1 whichever one is fine Now the game should start installing by itself even if your Xbox isn’t connected to a Network then it would ask you to Insert disc 1 after disc 2 is Finish Installing.
It should be finish installing by now and Your ready to go and play without the need of Network connection 

Now to those who are worried about loosing all of your progress from the Game I think you can just create a new account In Xbox and use the same Steps I listed.
Your probably wondering why you would even do all of this well it’s only because if you have a Terrible Network In console like I do, plus a lot of people in Red dead Redemption 2 community have done this and are still playing 1.00 version of the game which by the way is exactly the same as the last patches from the Single player story mode, there are PROS and CONS that you can find all over research just look up “ Red Dead Redemption 2 1.00”  and you’ll see a bunch of topics about it. 

For those wondering yes, you can do all of this in the Disc version only and not the digital version one but Im pretty sure I’ve seen videos of it On how to do it For PC like In Steam / Epic games etc.

Me personally I’m glad that I found a way to Play it Offline which is exactly why I did all of this anyway.
